text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE single full-body image. 2:3 portrait canvas, head-to-toe uncut, complete hair and shoes, 6% margin top and bottom. Strict straight-on FRONT view, head upright face symmetrical, shoulders and hips level, relaxed arms at sides hands visible, feet slightly apart on same baseline. Long lens neutral undistorted straight camera, no perspective foreshortening. Character-specific body: 186 cm excluding crown, supple youthful athletic frame. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Sapphire-blue floor-length layered brocade robes, navy collar, silver leaf embroidery, modest matching shoulder guards, silver-blue waist sash, dark blue embroidered boots.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 25. Long midnight-blue hair half-up, one slim icy silver streak on RIGHT side, small original brushed silver geometric crown clasp. Slate-blue eyes, broad oval face with soft cheek dimples, thicker straight eyebrows, medium slightly curved nose, wide cupid-bow lips, round square chin. Pale peach skin. Sapphire-blue layered brocade robes with navy collar, fine silver leaf embroidery and modest sculpted shoulder guards. Gentle knowing smile.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
